prefilter.note: PREFILTER_SIZE (64) unchanged from R2/R4. At the R5 bright-family footprint (mean ~18.5m diameter, ~16.9 texels across), 64 prefilter samples across the tight crop already oversamples the destination footprint several times over; increasing it further was not needed to eliminate the hard-block artifact (the alpha feather, not prefilter resolution, is what removes the box-edge discontinuity -- see notes).

alphaEdgeTreatment.technique: smooth alpha feather (allowed technique; not a blur, not recoloring)
alphaEdgeTreatment.description: For each texel inside a stamp's oriented box test, alpha is multiplied by a factor that is 1 while the Chebyshev-normalized distance to the box boundary is <= featherStart, and ramps via smoothstep to exactly 0 at the box boundary otherwise. RGB and interior alpha (distance <= featherStart) are untouched -- only the outer band of each stamp's own footprint is tapered. This guarantees the alpha field is continuous across every stamp boundary, eliminating the hard rectangular/stair-step block A5 attributed to the unmodified box test.

blockDetection.method: first-difference (neighbor-to-neighbor) scan of the FINAL output alpha channel, row-wise and column-wise; counts runs of consecutive texels whose difference exceeds jumpThresholdAlpha255, of length >= runLengthMinTexels
blockDetection.assertion: generate() asserts horizontalRunCount === 0 && verticalRunCount === 0 and throws (refuses to write output) otherwise.

maskOutsideAlphaVerification.method: re-decoded the PNG this generator just wrote (not the in-memory generation buffers) and scanned every texel classified non-forest by the same mask/threshold logic used during generation, reading alpha directly from the decoded PNG bytes
maskOutsideAlphaVerification.assertion: generate() asserts maxAlphaOutsideMask === 0 and throws otherwise.

grainDiagnostic.method: local reimplementation (not imported -- see notes) of measureCrownGrain.mjs's detrended-luminance horizontal+vertical autocorrelation, first-local-minimum method, applied directly to this texture's RGBA buffer (and, for comparison, to the existing R2/R4 textures) inside a verified all-forest crop near the texture center; NOT a screen-space render measurement (dev server/browser launch is out of scope for this task)
grainDiagnostic.caveat: This texture-space autocorrelation is dominated by the dense, heavily-overlapping stamp LATTICE (stampSpacingMeters=5.561m) rather than by individual stamp footprint size -- consistent with far-architecture-findings.md A6/PART B's own finding that PRIMARY-camera screen-space grain was identical between R3 and R4 despite very different stamp footprints. It is reported for completeness but should NOT be read as evidence that the R5 bright-family footprint reduction (see brightFamilyFootprint below) moved crown grain toward the 17.6-22.6m reference band; that claim rests on the analytic footprint-to-target-band comparison in brightFamilyFootprint, not on this diagnostic. A true screen-space verification would require rendering PRIMARY/OVERVIEW captures (dev server/browser launch), which is out of scope for this task.

brightFamilyFootprint.source: BROADLEAF_ROUND_LIGHT baked atlas, view=top (plan view), same as R4
brightFamilyFootprint.scaleSelectionHashIndex: b + 4 (same draw the grove pipeline uses for CONIFER_SCALE_MIN/MAX; reinterpreted into BRIGHT_SCALE_MIN/MAX only for family===BRIGHT_BROADLEAF stamps; no new hash index consumed)
brightFamilyFootprint.variantSelection: hashIndexTo01(b + 2, SEED) < 0.5 ? ROUND_LIGHT_A : ROUND_LIGHT_B (same as R4)
brightFamilyFootprint.yawSelection: yawIndex = min(3, floor(hashIndexTo01(b + 5, SEED) * 4)); yaw degrees = [0, 90, 180, 270] (same as R4)

appearanceParameters.note: Identical to far-canopy-r2-meta.json appearanceParameters; computed via the imported R2 selectionFamilyAt/colorMultiplierAt functions, not recomputed independently. Cross-checked at generation time against far-canopy-r2-meta.json (see crossCheckAgainstR2Meta()).

notes: この texture の stamp 配置は candidate 4/5 の cluster instance 配置とは独立のアルゴリズムであり、instance と 1:1 対応しない(前 phase から継承、design §10 RISK-2)。
同一 SEED・同一閉鎖度式・同一 mask を使うため統計的には整合するが、幾何的な一致は保証しない。
stamp 位置・個数・theta の hash、macro field / thresholds / GROVE_WEIGHTS_BY_FAMILY / color anchors / SEED は R2/R4 から不変。
family===BRIGHT_BROADLEAF の stamp は grove top atlas ではなく、baked BROADLEAF_ROUND_LIGHT の "top" cell(plan view, variant A/B, yaw 0/90/180/270)から引く(R4 から継承、変更なし)。

R5 で新規に変えたのは (1) BRIGHT_BROADLEAF stamp の footprint scale 範囲を CONIFER_SCALE_MIN/MAX から BRIGHT_SCALE_MIN=0.78/BRIGHT_SCALE_MAX=0.92 へ変更(同じ hash draw b+4 を再利用、新規 hash 消費なし)、(2) 全 stamp(grove/bright 問わず)に alpha feather を追加(featherStart=0.8、box 境界で alpha が正確に 0 へ滑らかに漸近する)。stamp 位置・個数・SEED・macro distribution は変更していない。

colorProcessing: none。stamp 位置に応じた color multiplier(colorMultiplierAt)は R2 から不変で継承された既存処理であり、grove 由来・BRL 由来を問わず全 stamp に同一に適用される(再着色ではない;既存 macro distribution の一部)。alpha feather は alpha チャンネルのみを操作し、RGB・色相・彩度・明度には一切触れていない。

block 検出は §24 の例示どおり、出力 alpha の 1 次差分(隣接 texel 間の絶対差)を行・列それぞれについて走査し、閾値(40/255)を超える差分が 28 texel 以上連続する run の数を数える方法。runLengthMin は生成時に実測した grove/bright 双方の最大 1 stamp 直径(texel 換算, 23.77px)+4px のマージンで、単一 stamp 自身の(feather済み)縁では届き得ない長さに設定している。scan は forest mask 内部のtexel ペアだけを対象とし、forest/非forest mask 境界(§36 G により意図的に alpha=0 への hard cutoff が要求される境界)は除外している(mask 境界と stamp 由来の block artifact を混同しないため)。生成器自身がこの検出結果をassert しており、block が検出された場合は出力を書き込まずに例外で停止する。

grain diagnostic (§36 J) は screen-space render (dev server 起動禁止のため未実施) ではなく、texture 空間で measureCrownGrain.mjs と同一の方法(detrended luminance の水平/垂直自己相関、最初の極小)をこのファイル内に再実装(measureCrownGrain.mjs の import は同ファイルが import 時に無条件で main() を実行し許可外の evidence ファイルへ書き込むため意図的に避けた)して直接適用したものであり、reference 写真との厳密な等価測定ではないproxy 指標である。詳細は meta.grainDiagnostic を参照。
